title: Trace relation proven to be a partial order at Heathrow

tellings.quote: so I took it to Jayton I said look Jayton I think this thing is a logic technically a partial order and he said Don it's too pretty to be true and he had to fly somewhere So he got to Heathrow and decided to check it and he proved it.

plain: A researcher named Don Hoffman tells Michels that he suspected a mathematical structure in his theory, which he calls the trace relation, was a logic, technically a partial order (a way of ranking things in which not every pair has to be comparable). He says he took it to a colleague named Jayton Posash, who told him "it's too pretty to be true," then flew off, checked it while at Heathrow airport, and proved it. For Hoffman it was a key step in the mathematics behind his ideas about reality.
